resources.string: Keep trades, the journal, watchlist and alerts in step with the Piso Tiyempo desktop app. Data is encrypted on this phone before it\'s sent; our server can\'t read it.
Scan the QR code in the desktop app (Settings › Link phone)
Create a link code on this phone instead
That isn\'t a valid link code. It starts with PT1.
Linked. Your data is syncing now.
This removes the encrypted copy from our server and unlinks this phone. Data on each device stays. Other linked devices stop syncing until you link them again.
In the desktop app, open Settings › Link phone › Enter code, and paste this. Keep a copy somewhere safe: it\'s also how you recover your synced data on a new phone.
Anyone with this code can read your synced data. Don\'t share it.
